test_cases.risk: Unauthorized lookup reaches provider or exposes an unsafe projection.
steps: Execute every authorized and denied lookup row.
expected_results: Exact status/body allowlist per row.
Provider lookup count is zero on every denied row.

test_cases.risk: Proposal mutability or actor/CAS authority bypass.
steps: Execute creation/read/decision error rows and race human decisions.
expected_results: Model/system decision is denied before write.
One human CAS winner and immutable material fields.

test_cases.risk: Authority revocation or compatibility mismatch causes provider write/effect.
steps: Execute success, closed rejection, indeterminate, contention, authority and compatibility rows.
expected_results: Denied/stale rows have zero admission/write/effect.
Valid path retains one logical ID/fingerprint.

test_cases.risk: Concurrent or replayed execution duplicates external effect.
steps: Race direct and replayed executions with same/different fingerprints.
expected_results: One admission and at most one effect.
Same input replays; different fingerprint conflicts.

test_cases.risk: Crash/restart reconciliation invents outcome or collapses closed provider failures.
steps: Run both crash windows and every success, closed failure and non-terminal row across restarts.
expected_results: Success and each closed rejection are distinct restart-stable rows.
No-receipt/ambiguous remain non-terminal until authorized recovery.

test_cases.risk: Lease boundary lets stale owner mutate state.
steps: Race current, foreign, stale and generation-mismatched owners around strict expiry.
expected_results: One takeover generation increment.
Only current unexpired owner observes/finalizes.

test_cases.risk: Audit cannot reconstruct decisions or leaks private material.
steps: Reconstruct full timeline and recursively scan evidence.
expected_results: Required actors/snapshots/outcomes are ordered and complete.
Leak scan is empty.

test_cases.risk: Migration works only from backend CWD or hides regression.
steps: Run root-CWD focused regression and clean upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade.
expected_results: All exits zero at 20260824_0040.
No skip/xfail/assertion weakening.

test_cases.risk: Exact candidate lacks full M1-M3 regression proof.
steps: Run focused M4, full suite, Ruff and Compose at tested subject without tracked drift.
expected_results: All required nodes pass.
Every skip/xfail is inventoried; only three pre-existing PDF skips remain.

test_cases.risk: Evidence descendant changes behavior or premature final review pins stale head.
steps: Classify candidate and evidence-only descendants; inspect main and readiness template.
expected_results: Changed product/test/configuration scope invalidates acceptance.
main stays unchanged and actual descriptor is absent.

test_cases.risk: Unapproved mutable guide or rewritten Evaluation history is treated as acceptance.
steps: Record pre-execution guide/history digests, append candidate run, then append separate human approval.
expected_results: Guide bytes and older records do not change.
Candidate and approval bind exact tested/evidence heads and PASSED verdict.
